verdict.label: STEP ASIDE — Bear Case Materialized; NFP 172K Voids HOLD Framework; Three Regime Breaches
verdict.rationale_short: May NFP printed 172K — more than double the 85K consensus and above the prior framework's explicit 165K bear-case threshold — forcing the immediate HOLD→STEP ASIDE reversion the prior brief mandated. Three regime indicators breached simultaneously: 30Y closed at 5.007% (voiding the Day-2 sub-5.0% sequence), VIX surged ~34% to approximately 20.9 (well above the 18 trigger), and the S&P 500 fell to 7,383.74 (breaking the 7,460 floor). NVDA's $215 unconditional stop was triggered as the stock fell to a low of $206.64. The Philadelphia SE Semiconductor Index posted its worst session since March 2020, erasing more than $1 trillion in market value. STEP ASIDE at medium conviction: June 10 CPI is an unknown binary that could reverse the calculus — high conviction requires CPI confirmation, not one hot labor print in isolation.

trade_setups.thesis: Gold closed at $4,569.90 (+0.83%) on June 5 — the only major asset in green among equity-correlated holdings. The hot NFP creating rate-hike expectations is simultaneously inflationary, supporting gold as an inflation hedge and a safe-haven asset. The Iran ceasefire MOU remains unsigned (Trump signature pending), maintaining geopolitical risk premium. In a STEP ASIDE regime with three indicators breached, gold is the cleanest active long: uncorrelated to the chip-sector unwind, benefiting from both inflation-fear and flight-to-safety demand streams.

bear_case: The STEP ASIDE verdict preserves optionality for a CPI-driven relief rally — but April's CPI printed 3.8% YoY (highest since mid-2023) and May's ISM Services Prices came in at 71.3% (highest since August 2022), two signals arguing against meaningful June 10 CPI deceleration. If CPI prints 3.7%+ with sticky core, the 30Y pushes toward 5.15-5.25%, Warsh removes the dovish bias on June 17, and the 'Parabolic 7' de-rating extends: MU's -13% today erases only 4-5% of a 273% YTD gain, leaving 25-35% more reversion risk if the basket reverts toward SOX-index performance. The SPCX $75B capital drain (June 8-12), the Warsh hawkish-signal risk (June 17), and the 'Parabolic 7' structural unwind converging in a single fortnight argue for immediate BEARISH conversion, not cautious STEP ASIDE. Invalidation: if June 10 CPI prints ≤3.5% YoY with core ≤3.3%, and the S&P 500 reclaims 7,460 within two sessions, revert STEP ASIDE to HOLD and reassess the NVDA re-entry framework.
